provenance: Transcribed from corpus/50-world/regions.json. Seam S24: Black Marsh is the name, not the terrain — thirteen regions, each a different place. Region CONTENT is owned by wave-1 piece W1-02; this file exists so W1-00's harness has real region data to report and to hash.

regions.name: Blackwood
regions.climate: heavy rain; light arrives only in shafts
regions.flora: buttressed hardwood, strangler vine, luminous fungus shelves
regions.fauna: chitin hounds (eyeless pack predators), tusk-lurkers, bandits
regions.architecture: Ayleid white-stone drowned to the second storey; Imperial logging camps; Gideon
regions.only_here: welkynd-lit Ayleid ruins swallowed by living wood: white stone with roots through it, glowing blue in green dark
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: The Clay Moor
regions.flora: sparse scrub on fired red clay; no standing water
regions.architecture: naga kiln-cities: domes fired in place, the kiln still burning beneath the floor
regions.hazard: naga territory - the only hostile CULTURE, with patrols, sentries and reprisal
regions.only_here: buildings that were fired like pots, with the kiln still lit underneath them
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Crimson Coast
regions.flora: crimson tide-lichen covering every surface to the high-water mark
regions.architecture: Archon's kiln-fired clay domes; open dye-vats on the strand
regions.hazard: dye-fume sickness (named disease, curable); slick lichen on rock
regions.only_here: a coastline that is red because it is alive, and screams thinly under your boots
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: The Deep Marshes
regions.climate: green fever-fog carrying a named disease
regions.flora: corpse-lily, drowned trees, black standing water
regions.fauna: voriplasm (living mud), naga raiders, unnamed things
regions.architecture: nothing stands - only drowned xanmeers breaking surface like teeth
regions.hazard: THE GROUND IS AN ANIMAL - voriplasm swallows and digests; instant-death sinks
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Eastern Rootlands
regions.climate: humid; night bioluminescence turns the water into a second sky
regions.architecture: stilt-row villages on platforms that rise and fall with the tide
regions.hazard: tide-gated paths; drowning; you can be cut off for 6 real minutes
regions.only_here: translucent bell-organisms drifting metres above the water, glowing at night, throwing moving light down onto it
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: The Hive
regions.climate: none - it is always warm and still; rain does not fall inside the hive's air
regions.fauna: hive drones the size of dogs; one queen
regions.architecture: the hive IS the architecture: waxen towers, comb-cliffs, sphincter doors
regions.hazard: the floor is comb and gives way; falls into sealed cells
regions.only_here: a region with no weather and no plants, whose floor is edible and load-bearing only sometimes
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Marauder's Coast
regions.climate: sea-fog banks rolling in on a ~6 minute cycle
regions.fauna: mire-crabs (cart-sized, used as pack animals), gulls, drowned-things at night
regions.architecture: bone-scaffold towers of lashed leviathan ribs; ship hulls beached hull-up and lived in
regions.hazard: the tide - flats flood and strand you
regions.only_here: whole ships walked up the shore and inhabited hull-up, chimneys punched through the keel
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: The Salt Hills
regions.climate: cold rain; snow visible on unreachable peaks
regions.flora: hill grass, salt-cedar, gorse; the only place with open sky over dry ground
regions.fauna: guar herds, hill-wamasu, Dunmer slaver-raiders coming down the passes
regions.architecture: Imperial cut stone: milestones, watchtowers on every third hill, a legion fort
regions.hazard: slaver ambush on the pass roads; exposure on the ridge at night
regions.only_here: Imperial road-milestones with distances carved in Cyrodilic - the only place in Argonia where anyone measured anything
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: The Stone Forest
regions.climate: clear high light; sudden dry thunder with no rain
regions.flora: living trees standing among petrified ones; stone-bark indistinguishable until touched
regions.architecture: xanmeer ziggurats; Helstrom grown into the greatest Hist in Argonia
regions.only_here: a forest half turned to stone, where you cannot tell which trees are alive until you put a hand on one
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Stone Wastes
regions.climate: salt-storms (ash-storm analogue): visibility to 15 m, chip damage over time
regions.fauna: salt-worms, bone-pickers, the last dying Hist
regions.architecture: Soulrest: whale-bone frames and salt-block walls, bleached white
regions.hazard: no water; salt-storm strips health; the storm hides everything including enemies
regions.only_here: crater-fields - perfectly circular pits of glassed salt, and no one will say what made them
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Thornmarsh
regions.climate: grey ash carried south from Morrowind, dusting every surface
regions.flora: black needle-thorn thickets 6 m tall, impenetrable except on cut paths
regions.fauna: hackwings nesting in thorn, feral guar, thorn-spiders
regions.architecture: Thorn village: thatch of black thorn over a rotted Argonian great-hall
regions.hazard: no sightlines - the thicket is a maze and the cut paths are re-cut weekly
regions.only_here: an ash-dusted thorn labyrinth navigated by knife-marks cut into stems
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Valus Ridge
regions.climate: cold rain, cloud BELOW the player on high paths
regions.flora: stunted thorn-pine, hanging moss curtains, cliff-lichen
regions.architecture: Ayleid watchtowers and Imperial border cairns; nothing lived in
regions.hazard: falls; hackwings that stagger you off ledges (Souls-style plunge deaths)
regions.only_here: the rock flutes - wind-holed limestone spires that hum a fixed chord audible from 400 m and usable as a compass
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)

regions.name: Western Rootlands
regions.flora: reed, paddy-fern, and root-arches 8 m high over the road
regions.architecture: root-arch villages and nest-mounds; Blackrose's prison walls; Lilmoth's stilt slum
regions.hazard: low - mudcrabs, thieves, the occasional slaver press-gang
regions.only_here: the road IS a Hist root - you walk on living wood that flexes underfoot and the arches are its branches
regions.provenance: corpus/50-world/regions.json (seam S24: the map is authoritative)
